page.overview:
Who is Azmog?

was the vampiric hobgoblin commander of the garrison of the Steel Keep, a prison camp in Rybad-Kol near the end of the Calamity. As an NPC, was played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

When he appeared on the walls of the fortress prison addressing the prisoners, Azmog wore black armor. He had coiffed hair and distinctive ears..}}

Azmog was cruel and ruthless, willing to kill casually and seeing the prisoners as cattle to be controlled, used up, and disposed of.

Sundering Lord Azmog addressed the thousand assembled prisoners on their knees before him, telling them that soon they would be marching to fight in the final defeat of the Prime Deities in the forces of the Strife Emperor. The All-Hammer, the Platinum Dragon, and the Moonweaver were already dead, and soon the rest would be, too. The hobgoblin prisoner in his grasp, a secret follower of the Changebringer who had preached the hope for change, was forced to recant under the threat of his family being killed before his eyes, but Azmog cruelly killed him anyway, licking the viscera from his fingers before sending the prisoners back to work.
